title: ED A555K: Culturally Responsive Teaching: A Framework for Teaching and Learning in Alaska
description: Examines culturally responsive teaching as a model for teaching and learning in Alaska. Provides educators with opportunities to examine and analyze current research, theory, principles, and effective instructional practices in curriculum and instruction. Focuses on current content theory, research, and knowledge; standards-based instructional design and practice; assessment and evaluation practices; and integrated/interdisciplinary curriculum design. Promotes application of effective curriculum development and instruction that utilizes collaboration as well as individual reflection.
instructor: Kathleen Brennan Tollefson, Jennifer Greene, Tammy Halfacre
